name: Better late than never
tamilMeaning: தாமதமானாலும் பரவாயில்லை; செய்யாமல் இருப்பதை விட நல்லது
example: He finally apologized. Better late than never.
exampleTamil: இறுதியாக அவர் மன்னிப்பு கேட்டார். தாமதமானாலும் பரவாயில்லை.

name: In the nick of time
example: We reached the station in the nick of time.

name: Around the clock
example: Doctors worked around the clock.

name: Ahead of time
example: She arrived ahead of time.

name: Behind the times
example: His ideas are behind the times.

name: Call it a day
example: Let's call it a day.

name: Once in a while
example: I visit my grandparents once in a while.
exampleTamil: நான் எப்போதாவது ஒருமுறை தாத்தா பாட்டியைப் பார்க்கச் செல்வேன்.

name: From time to time
example: We meet from time to time.

name: Time flies
example: Time flies when you're having fun.

name: Against the clock
example: We worked against the clock.

name: At the eleventh hour
example: The plan changed at the eleventh hour.

name: In no time
example: You'll finish it in no time.

name: For the time being
example: Stay here for the time being.

name: Have the time of your life
example: We had the time of our lives on vacation.

name: Time is money
example: Don't waste time. Time is money.

name: Second to none
example: Her dedication is second to none.

name: Like clockwork
example: The train arrives like clockwork.

name: Behind schedule
example: The project is behind schedule.
exampleTamil: திட்டம் திட்டமிட்ட நேரத்தை விட தாமதமாக உள்ளது.

name: Ahead of schedule
example: We finished ahead of schedule.

name: Time will tell
example: Time will tell if we made the right choice.
exampleTamil: நாம் சரியான முடிவு எடுத்தோமா என்பதை காலம்தான் சொல்லும்.
